Tape Quirk.name: Tape Quirk
Tape Quirk.description:
📼 You make long, sticky strips of tape from your elbows.

🌱 At the start you shoot tape several meters, pull a small object, bind one person's wrists or swing across a short gap, reeling attached strips or tearing them free.
📈 With training: longer swings, quick turns, falling-person catches, broad nets that restrain several people.
⚠️ You need sound anchors; heat, blades or force cut tape, heavy targets unbalance you, detached strips stay still, and overuse dries and hurts your elbows.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as prolonged output dries and irritates your elbows.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Hanta Sero's Tape. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Elbow Strip Shot, Sticky Wrist Wrap
Tape Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: elbow tape dispensers. Start: several-meter sticky strips onto people or surfaces, torn off or reeled back; pull a small object, bind wrists, swing short gaps from sound high anchors. Longer lines, quick turns, catching fallers, broad restraints need training.
Limits: tape travels physically from the elbows; never appears afar, moves detached or changes substance. Smooth, dirty, crumbling anchors may fail; heat, blades, force sever it; big targets pull the user off balance. Overuse dries elbow skin, cutting output until rest.
Quirk Strain: light: short shot, wrist wrap; moderate: swing, rescue catch, anchors; heavy: broad net, long aerial movement; severe: big coordinated restraint, continuous output.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Hanta Sero's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: tape restraints or route blocks need lawful purpose and care.
Look: elbow tubes.
